{{- /*
  /llms.txt for the site, per https://llmstxt.org: an H1 with the site name, a
  blockquote summary, then H2 sections of "- [name](url): notes" link lists, with
  secondary links under "## Optional". Rendered once, from the home page, by
  partials/llms-txt.html (called in baseof.html), so a site needs no config.

  Summary: the home page's description (content/_index.md), else
  params.description, else params.introDescription; left out if none is set.

  Top pages (optional): data/llms_top.yaml in the site repo, written by bin's
  llms_top.py, shaped as
    pages:
      - title: "Page title"
        url: "/post/some-slug/"
        note: "optional one-line note"
  Without that file the section is left out.

  Turn it off for a site with params.llmsTxt = false.
*/ -}}
{{- $clean := `[\[\]]` -}}
{{- $summary := or .Description site.Params.description site.Params.introDescription -}}
# {{ site.Title }}
{{ with $summary }}
> {{ . | plainify | replaceRE `\s+` " " | strings.TrimSpace }}
{{ end }}
{{- with site.Menus.main }}
## Sections

{{ range . -}}
- [{{ .Name | replaceRE $clean "" | replaceRE `\s+` " " | strings.TrimSpace }}]({{ .URL | absURL }}){{ with .Page }}{{ with .Description }}: {{ . | plainify | replaceRE `\s+` " " | strings.TrimSpace }}{{ end }}{{ end }}
{{ range .Children -}}
- [{{ .Name | replaceRE $clean "" | replaceRE `\s+` " " | strings.TrimSpace }}]({{ .URL | absURL }})
{{ end -}}
{{ end -}}
{{ end -}}
{{- with site.Data.llms_top }}{{ with .pages }}
## Top pages

{{ range . -}}
- [{{ .title | replaceRE $clean "" | replaceRE `\s+` " " | strings.TrimSpace }}]({{ .url | absURL }}){{ with .note }}: {{ . | replaceRE `\s+` " " | strings.TrimSpace }}{{ end }}
{{ end -}}
{{ end }}{{ end -}}
{{- $sections := site.Params.mainSections | default (slice "post") -}}
{{- $posts := first 10 (where site.RegularPages "Section" "in" $sections).ByDate.Reverse -}}
{{- $cats := site.Taxonomies.categories -}}
{{- if or $posts $cats }}
## Optional

{{ range $posts -}}
- [{{ .Title | replaceRE $clean "" | replaceRE `\s+` " " | strings.TrimSpace }}]({{ .Permalink }}){{ with .Description }}: {{ . | plainify | replaceRE `\s+` " " | strings.TrimSpace }}{{ end }}
{{ end -}}
{{ with $cats }}{{ range first 15 .ByCount -}}
- [Category: {{ .Page.Title | replaceRE $clean "" | replaceRE `\s+` " " | strings.TrimSpace }}]({{ .Page.Permalink }})
{{ end -}}{{ end -}}
{{- end -}}
